title: A gate that names the kbmon querylog panel is not classed querylog
goal: bl_authority.derived_class classes a gate querylog only when its words name the query log store or its recording (query log, redact of recorded fields) or the item touches kb/_querylog/, not when an option names kbmon's querylog panel
notes: SP-kgvbpjhd retro: ST-rwan4x2o g1 (which panels the receipt reads) was classed querylog because an option named the querylog panel; BG-rpp4dsrn g1 likewise for the word 'redacts'. The class is not operator-only, but an orchestrator acting under the operator-only rule for query-log recorded fields had to check by hand.
